about: Labelled pairs for npm run precedent:calibrate. Each query is a check statement as the index stores it (already redacted). A match is the same check worded another way: the same thing measured, under the same condition. A non-match is a different check on the same kind of page. Variants that differ in one parameter (375px and 1440px, mobile and desktop) are left out on purpose: the reranker scores them as close, and the case line shows both statements so either side can see the difference.
